items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yeah, I played with Bobby in California.

ctx.x: Yes, we had five pieces. Rush panel and spare horn.
What's the drummer's name from here? He was playing with you wasn't he? Yes. Bobby. Yeah, I played with Bobby in California.
Bobby. He was in that band. He was in that band.
